routes.process: Print a large poster on a plotter
routes.fit_reason: This is the direct way to print research posters at Leavey Library. Staff are on site to help.

steps.title: Prepare the file
steps.detail: Check that your poster file measures 36 by 48 inches and is ready to print.

steps.title: Load funds
steps.detail: Load discretionary funds on your USC Card to pay for the print.

steps.title: Bring file to center
steps.detail: Bring your file to the Leavey computing center and ask ITS staff on site for help.

warnings.issue: Poster dimensions may not match paper width if set incorrectly.
warnings.fix: Double-check your file dimensions before you go.

routes.process: Print a large poster using plotters
routes.fit_reason: Another option in Leavey Library for large format printing.

steps.title: Prepare the file
steps.detail: Make sure your poster file is formatted correctly for printing.

steps.title: Ask staff
steps.detail: Ask the ITS Learning Environments team how to print on the plotters.

steps.title: Print the poster
steps.detail: Follow staff instructions to print your poster.

warnings.issue: Printing procedures are not listed on the page.
warnings.fix: Ask staff for guidance on file types and paper.
